mapper.select:
select DISTINCT T1.PTL_STGY_ID ptlStgyId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T3.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, T1.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, T3.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, T3.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc, DATE_FORMAT(T1.EFF_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') effDate
from PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY T1 left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL T2 on T2.PTL_STGY_ID = T1.PTL_STGY_ID left join PTL_INV_STRATEGY T3 on T3.STRATEGY_ID = T1.STRATEGY_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 on T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_INCOME_INDEX T5 on T5.INDEX_ID = T2.INDEX_ID
where 1=1
AND (T1.PORTFOLIO_ID in
null) OR T1.PORTFOLIO_ID in (
#{item} )
AND (T1.STRATEGY_ID in
null) OR T1.STRATEGY_ID in (
#{item} )
AND T3.STRATEGY_TYPE in
#{item}
AND T1.EFF_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{startEffDate},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{endEffDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

select rate.INT_RATE*100 intRate from MST_INT_RATE_INFO rate where rate.EFF_DATE = ( select MAX(EFF_DATE) from MST_INT_RATE_INFO where EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')) and rate.INT_RATE_ID = #{indexId}

select T1.PTL_STGY_ID ptlStgyId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T4.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T3.STRATEGY_TYPE strategyType, T1.STRATEGY_ID strategyId, T3.STRATEGY_NAME strategyName, T3.STRATEGY_DESC strategyDesc, DATE_FORMAT(T1.EFF_DATE,'%Y-%m-%d') effDate, T2.INDEX_ID indexId, T5.INCOME_TYPE incomeType, T5.INCOME_TARGET*100 incomeTarget, T5.MAX_INCOME_TARGET*100 maxIncomeTarget, T5.MIN_INCOME_TARGET*100 minIncomeTarget ,t2.EVAL_INDEX, CASE WHEN t2.EVAL_INDEX IS NOT NULL THEN '01' ELSE '02' END tableShowFlag from PTL_PORTFOLIO_STGY T1 left join PTL_PORTFOLIO_EVAL T2 on T2.PTL_STGY_ID = T1.PTL_STGY_ID left join PTL_INV_STRATEGY T3 on T3.STRATEGY_ID = T1.STRATEGY_ID left join PTL_PORTFOLIO T4 on T4.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.PORTFOLIO_ID left join PTL_INCOME_INDEX T5 on T5.INDEX_ID = T2.INDEX_ID where 1=1
AND T1.PTL_STGY_ID = #{ptlStgyId}
